newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian magistrates name SGS-Thomson CEO in probe.
newsitem.headline: Italian magistrates name SGS-Thomson CEO in probe.

text.p: Italian magistrates are investigating whether Pasquale Pistorio, chief executive officer of Franco-Italian group SGS-Thomson Microelectronics, misused funds allocated for research, the company said on Monday.
The company said in a statement that Pistorio was one of 11 people being investigated over allegations the company used government funds earmarked for research for its own business.
SGS-Thomson did not say how much cash was involved. It said the funds were intended to be used by a research consortium formed by SGS-Thomson and the University of Catania, in Sicily.
"As we have said all along, the company is confident it has fully respected all its obligations, contractual and otherwise," the statement said.
